name: OpenAI
description: Trigger workflows when an OpenAI batch or fine-tuning job finishes or a file is uploaded, and create responses, chat completions, embeddings, moderations and batches from a step.

triggers.label: A batch finishes
triggers.description: Fires once when a batch reaches completed, failed, expired or cancelled. The list has no status filter, so every batch created inside the look-back is read and the terminal ones kept.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys (Create new secret key) and set OPENAI_API_KEY on the connection.
env.builderHint: A standard or project key (sk-… or sk-proj-…), not an Admin key: Admin keys serve only the Administration API. Permissions are set per key at creation; a key that lacks an endpoint answers 401 insufficient permissions. Pasted whitespace is trimmed.

env.name: OPENAI_ORGANIZATION
env.description: Organization id (org-…), sent as OpenAI-Organization. Only needed when the key belongs to more than one organization.
env.builderHint: Settings → Organization → General. Leave empty for a project key, which is already scoped.

env.name: OPENAI_PROJECT
env.description: Project id (proj_…), sent as OpenAI-Project. Only needed when a legacy user key should bill one project.
env.builderHint: Settings → Project → General. Leave empty for a project key.

env.name: OPENAI_BATCH_ENDPOINT
env.description: Only batches for this endpoint, such as /v1/chat/completions. Empty delivers every batch.
env.builderHint: The list has no server-side filter; the connector compares the batch object’s endpoint field.

env.name: OPENAI_BATCH_LOOKBACK_HOURS
env.description: How far before the watermark the batch poll reads, because a batch finishes up to a day after it is created.
env.builderHint: Raise it if batches take longer than two days to finish or expire; lower it for a busy account.

env.name: OPENAI_FILE_PURPOSE
env.description: Only files uploaded with this purpose (assistants, assistants_output, batch, batch_output, fine-tune, fine-tune-results, vision, user_data). Empty delivers every file.
env.builderHint: Passed through as the purpose query parameter, so the API does the filtering.

env.name: OPENAI_FINE_TUNING_LOOKBACK_HOURS
env.description: How far before the watermark the fine-tuning poll reads, because a job is created long before it finishes.
env.builderHint: A week by default. Jobs that queue longer than this before finishing are missed.

triggers.label: A file is uploaded
triggers.description: Fires once per file uploaded since the last poll, newest first from GET /files.

actions.label: Create a response
actions.description: Ask a model for a response with the Responses API, optionally constrained to a JSON schema. Spends tokens; not stored unless asked.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Model id, such as gpt-4o-mini.
inputs.builderHint: Any id listModels returns. A fine-tuned model is its ft:… id.

inputs.label: Input
inputs.description: Plain text, or a JSON array of message items { role, content } with role user, assistant, system or developer.
inputs.builderHint: A value that parses as a JSON array is sent as the array; anything else is sent as text.

inputs.label: Instructions
inputs.description: A system or developer message inserted into the model’s context.
inputs.builderHint: Prefer this over a system message in input; it is not carried into a later turn.

inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 2. Lower is more deterministic.
inputs.builderHint: Alter this or top_p, not both; leave empty for the model default of 1.

inputs.label: Max output tokens
inputs.description: Upper bound on generated tokens, including reasoning tokens. Sent as max_output_tokens.
inputs.builderHint: The API refuses values under 16. A response cut here reports incompleteReason max_output_tokens.

inputs.label: JSON schema
inputs.description: A JSON Schema object the output must match, sent as text.format json_schema with strict true.
inputs.builderHint: Strict mode wants every property in required and additionalProperties false. The parsed result is the json output.

inputs.label: Schema name
inputs.description: Name of the format, letters, digits, underscores and dashes up to 64 characters. Default output.
inputs.builderHint: Only read when schema is given.

inputs.label: Store the response
inputs.description: Keep the response retrievable for 30 days. Off here by default, unlike the API.
inputs.builderHint: true when a later step needs previous_response_id.

outputs.description: Every output_text part of every message, joined
The text parsed as JSON when a schema was given, else null
Why the response stopped early, or null

actions.label: Create a chat completion
actions.description: Ask a model for the next message in a conversation with the Chat Completions API. Spends tokens.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Model id, such as gpt-4o-mini.
inputs.builderHint: Any id listModels returns. A fine-tuned model is its ft:… id.

inputs.label: Messages
inputs.description: A JSON array of { role, content } with role system, developer, user, assistant or tool.
inputs.builderHint: One object is taken as a single message.

inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 2. Lower is more deterministic.
inputs.builderHint: Alter this or top_p, not both; leave empty for the model default of 1.

inputs.label: Max completion tokens
inputs.description: Upper bound on generated tokens, including reasoning tokens. Sent as max_completion_tokens.
inputs.builderHint: max_tokens is deprecated and refused by o-series models, so this never sends it.

inputs.label: Response format
inputs.description: JSON: { "type": "text" }, { "type": "json_object" } or { "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": { name, schema, strict } }.
inputs.builderHint: json_object needs the word JSON somewhere in the messages or the API refuses.

outputs.description: stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter or function_call
The refusal message of the first choice, or null

actions.label: Create embeddings
actions.description: Turn text into embedding vectors. The same input yields the same vectors and nothing is stored.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large or text-embedding-ada-002.
inputs.builderHint: text-embedding-3-small is the cheapest; dimensions only works on the 3 series.

inputs.label: Input
inputs.description: Plain text, or a JSON array of strings to embed in one call.
inputs.builderHint: Each string at most 8192 tokens, an array at most 2048 entries.

inputs.label: Dimensions
inputs.description: How many dimensions each vector should have. text-embedding-3 models only.
inputs.builderHint: Leave empty for the model default (1536 for small, 3072 for large).

outputs.description: Array of number arrays, in input order

actions.label: Moderate text
actions.description: Classify text against OpenAI’s usage policies. Free, and nothing is stored.

inputs.label: Input
inputs.description: Plain text, or a JSON array of strings to classify separately.
inputs.builderHint: One result per string, in order.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: omni-moderation-latest (default), omni-moderation-2024-09-26, text-moderation-latest or text-moderation-stable.
inputs.builderHint: Leave empty for omni-moderation-latest.

outputs.description: True when any result is flagged
Array of { flagged, categories, category_scores, category_applied_input_types }

actions.label: List models
actions.description: List the models the key can use, with their owner.

outputs.description: Array of { id, created, ownedBy, shutdownDate }

actions.label: Get a model
actions.description: Read one model by id. An unknown id answers 404 model_not_found.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Model id, such as gpt-4o-mini.
inputs.builderHint: Any id listModels returns. A fine-tuned model is its ft:… id.

actions.label: List files
actions.description: List uploaded files, newest first, optionally by purpose.

inputs.label: Purpose
inputs.description: Only files uploaded with this purpose.
inputs.builderHint: Leave empty for every purpose.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: 1 to 10,000 files per page; default 100.
inputs.builderHint: The API default is 10,000, which is a lot to hand a workflow step.

inputs.label: Order
inputs.description: Sort by created_at. Default desc.
inputs.builderHint: asc with after walks a backlog oldest first.

inputs.label: After
inputs.description: A file id from an earlier page; the list continues after it.
inputs.builderHint: Feed lastId from the previous call.

outputs.description: Array of { id, filename, bytes, purpose, createdAt, expiresAt }
Id of the last file listed, for after

actions.label: Get a batch
actions.description: Read one batch by id, with its status, request counts and output files.

inputs.label: Batch
inputs.description: Batch id, such as batch_abc123.
inputs.builderHint: Often {{trigger.item.id}} from the batch trigger. $NAME reads the environment for live checks.

outputs.description: validating, failed, in_progress, finalizing, completed, expired, cancelling or cancelled
The file of results, once completed
The file of failed requests, or null
When it was cancelled, or null
The metadata it was created with

actions.label: Create a batch
actions.description: Queue a batch of requests from an uploaded JSONL file. Each call queues a new batch that runs and bills.

inputs.label: Input file
inputs.description: Id of an uploaded JSONL file with purpose batch, one request per line.
inputs.builderHint: Upload with the Files API first; this connector does not upload.

inputs.label: Endpoint
inputs.description: The endpoint every request in the file targets.
inputs.builderHint: Must match the url field of each line in the file.

inputs.label: Completion window
inputs.description: How long the batch has to finish. Only 24h is supported; default 24h.
inputs.builderHint: Left as a select so a future window can be added without a code change.

inputs.label: Metadata
inputs.description: A JSON object of up to 16 string pairs, keys up to 64 characters and values up to 512.
inputs.builderHint: Comes back on the batch object and in the trigger item’s data.metadata.

outputs.description: validating, failed, in_progress, finalizing, completed, expired, cancelling or cancelled
The file of results, once completed
The file of failed requests, or null
When it was cancelled, or null
The metadata it was created with
